title: The Fall of English Normandy

opening.boundary: Authored late-year cutoff after the stated background developments; not their occurrence date.
opening.label: 15 December 1450 · after the year’s turning points

briefing: Formigny and the surrender of Cherbourg have completed the collapse of English rule in Normandy. Gascony and Calais remain separate problems; Normandy's recovery does not already settle Bordeaux. English domestic unrest and defeat complicate diplomacy without predetermining a civil war.
